content: As of our current understanding, the age of the universe is estimated to be about 13.8 billion years. This estimate is based on various methods, including observations of the cosmic microwave background radiation, the expansion rate of the universe measured by the Hubble constant, and the ages of the oldest star clusters. These measurements are refined over time with advancements in technology and astronomy.
